mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at overcast skies with a temperature of 84 degrees at Harriet Park. Please be aware that the air quality index is currently 52, which is in the moderate range. We are currently in the third quarter moon phase.

In city news, the City of Verona has officially installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics public art sculpture at Century School, a project created by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland. Additionally, residents are reminded that information regarding upcoming elections and sample ballots for the November general election is available on the city website.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can join a class at Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus Brewing Company for trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.

The Verona Police Department released their weekly report for the period of August 24 through August 31. Among the notable calls for service, officers successfully identified and caught individuals responsible for a string of ding-dong-ditch incidents that occurred last week.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a visit.
